content: TriviaQA BIBREF4 comprises of over 95K web question-answer-evidence triples. Like SQuAD, the answers are spans of text. Similar to the setting in SQuAD, we create multiple smaller subsets of the entire set. For our semi-supervised QA system, we use the BiDAF+SA model BIBREF1 – the highest performing publicly available system for TrivaQA. Here again, we compare the supervised learning (SL) settings against the pretraining on Cloze set and fine tuning on the supervised set. We report F1 and EM scores on the dev set.
